1. What Is LIVED IT?

LIVED IT is a community-driven Solana project built around something every person on Earth has in common: we have all lived through something.

Most meme projects begin with a character, a mascot, or a passing trend. LIVED IT begins with people. The stories are the memes. The experiences are the content. The community becomes the identity of the project.

If you lived it, you can tell it. And wherever you come from — everyone belongs.

2. The Idea

$LIVED turns real-life experience into a continuously expanding source of community-created content. Instead of asking a community to repeatedly promote the same mascot, LIVED IT gives people a framework for telling their own stories.

The primary format is simple: four panels, one experience, one story. Members create their own LIVED IT memes using the project's templates and branding. There's no requirement that a story be extraordinary — that's the point. Life itself provides the content.

3. A Global Community

LIVED IT was designed from the beginning to extend beyond one country, culture, or language. The project is developing a collection of country badges representing communities around the world, released progressively rather than all at once.

No theory. Lived it. Everyone belongs.

4. $LIVED Token

Token: LIVED IT

Ticker: $LIVED

Blockchain: Solana

Total Supply: 1,000,000,000 $LIVED

Launch Platform: Jupiter Studio (Custom mode)

$LIVED functions as the economic layer underneath the LIVED IT community — connecting participation, staking, rewards, and long-term ecosystem growth.

5. Launch Philosophy

The launch is structured around three principles: protection, transparency, longevity.

LIVED IT used Jupiter Studio's built-in anti-sniper protection to make automated sniping economically unattractive during the most vulnerable moments of launch, as configured for this token at launch time.

6. Creator Token Allocation

The project uses a deliberately conservative creator allocation: 10% of total supply — 100,000,000 $LIVED — placed into a transparent lock/vesting structure rather than left liquid.

The lock is publicly documented so holders can independently verify the structure. The purpose is simple: the creator should be building alongside the community, not preparing an exit from it.

7. Trading Fees

$LIVED carries a 2% creator/project trading fee. Rather than treating this as simple creator income, LIVED IT allocates every dollar of fee revenue according to a fixed policy:

Staking & Community Rewards 50%
Growth & Operations 22%
Long-Term Reserve 15%
Creator Compensation 10%
Team Compensation 3%

87% Ecosystem & Community · 10% Creator · 3% Team

8. Staking

Staking is intended to become a core part of the long-term $LIVED ecosystem, using a Solana-compatible staking solution allowing holders to stake circulating $LIVED.

Rewards are intended to be denominated in SOL where technically practical. The project may initially seed the reward pool so staking can begin before meaningful fee revenue accumulates. Staking rewards are not guaranteed and the pool may start empty.

9. Community Rewards

Not every valuable contribution happens through buying tokens. LIVED IT intends to recognize contributors who create memes, stories, artwork, translations, country participation, moderation, and organic promotion — including through an early contributor recognition program.

10. Why There's No Large Community Allocation at Launch

Rather than removing a large portion of supply at launch under project control, LIVED IT builds community rewards progressively through project-generated revenue. Build the treasury through growth — rather than simply assigning ourselves one.

11. Brand

LIVED IT has an official visual identity, and community members are encouraged to create original material within the project's branding framework. The goal isn't for thousands of people to repeat the same meme — it's to give thousands of people a recognizable way to tell different stories.

Community members may create stories and memes within the template. Trademarks, the official contract, and official badge files remain with the project.

12. The Long-Term Vision

LIVED IT begins as a meme-driven Solana community. It doesn't have to end there — the concept can extend into community storytelling, digital collectibles, creator programs, staking, social campaigns, merchandise, partnerships, and additional community-built applications. These are directions, not promises — development follows what the community actually builds and supports.

13. Transparency

Where practical, major project-controlled structures are independently verifiable on-chain — supply, creator allocation, lock/vesting, project wallets, and staking structures.

Nothing in this document is financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. NFA — this is not financial advice. This is not a security offering — there is no equity, dividend, or profit-share claim. Fee-based compensation reflects work performed, not a return on holding. Only participate with funds you can afford to lose.

LIVED IT is not built around a promise that a token will make people rich. It's built around an idea that already exists whether a token does or not:

Everybody has a story.
